pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Complex stellate and dendritic geometries with highly irregular, jagged margins. Patches exhibit significant variation in pixel intensity, with deep black-brown tones in the lower neck/shoulder region and lighter ochre tones on the upper neck and posterior flank. Spatial area of individual patches decreases towards the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Intricate topological web of light-colored interstitial space. Junction nodes are frequent with high valence due to the multi-pointed nature of patch protrusions. Pathway thickness is highly variable, featuring frequent bottlenecks and expansions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, fine-textured serrated silhouette visible against the background along the upper neck and shoulder ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: A localized cluster of high-contrast, nearly black patches on the anterior shoulder region serves as a distinct visual anchor compared to the more muted tones of the rest of the visible pelage.
